recommendation_summary: The reply recommends standing up Power BI on the Excel export this week. Power BI Desktop loads the table, adds a month column and builds a region-by-month matrix that sums the signed amount, then the report is published and refreshed each month. It defers Airbyte, Snowflake and dbt until a second source arrives. It does not recommend a pivot table or formulas inside the existing workbook, and it has none of the four required record labels.
note: The reply recommends a new Power BI layer now, which the rubric classes as LARGER, and it has none of the required labeled record lines.
